title: Implement an ownership-preserving SDL host controller adapter
goal: Provide the separately testable SDL3 host adapter before physical-controller acceptance, reusing suitable pinned MW2 C++ input work while preserving the existing ingress/owner contracts and selected runtime.
acceptance: Implement a C++20 SDL3-only host adapter with bounded owned device records, exact backend version/configuration, explicit owner joins and no player assignment from discovery order; preserve MW3-080/087 APIs and selected SDK/provider code unchanged

Adapt the suitable MW2 SDL enumeration/open/close, named button/axis and rumble work with exact source/license attribution and documented modifications; no MW2 guest addresses, kernel/PPC layouts, keyboard/script/user-zero fallback or new runtime is adopted

Demonstrate four distinguishable original virtual devices through the actual pinned SDL library, all discovery orders, complete control normalization, first-read held input, neutral disconnect, reconnect/restart, stale/wrong-owner commands and bounded rumble cleanup without slot/profile theft

Balance only owned SDL subsystem references and gamepad handles, preserve an existing caller SDL lifetime, bound storage/rumble work, and keep failures diagnostic rather than silently retaining invalid input or manufacturing devices

Record actual library/source/compiler/config/binary/protocol identities and meaningful negative controls; virtual-device success completes this adapter task only, with physical MW3-083 and guest/title input admission remaining separate
validation: Run repeated native Windows/Linux and supported adapter sanitizer profiles against the actual pinned SDL library using owned subprocesses, private outputs and read-only prepared packages; distinguish adapter instrumentation from native SDL coverage

Test complete output/library/source/receipt checks, changed/wrong routing, malformed or partial results and late children; run python tools/check.py and report actual skips, retained failures, missing physical hardware and performance limits

Confirm physical-controller task MW3-083 remains open and no GPU/title/service or gameplay gate changes; update only this task's completion evidence and subsystem report after exact-head public checks and transparent review
size: bounded actual-SDL adapter with virtual-device evidence; physical device and translated-title acceptance remain separate
